manual_review_reason: The first-party route requires a signed music-consent form, a direct MP3 email attachment, clean-content compliance and mastering checks. A human must inspect the inaccessible consent terms and Google-form controls, confirm international and AI-music eligibility, verify all rights and metadata, and explicitly approve the signed form, attachment, email and final send action.

The active free international route requires genre-specific selection, constant-bitrate MP3 preparation, metadata and silence checks, a ZIP package, a WeTransfer or Dropbox upload and a first-party contact-form submission. A human must review rights, external-hosting privacy and permissions, unpublished AI eligibility, hidden anti-spam controls and every upload and final submit action.
